description: This source file defines the structure and evaluation logic for command approval within an application. It includes a data model 'ExecApprovalEvaluation' and a static utility 'ExecApprovalEvaluator' with methods for evaluating command approvals and checking if skills are auto-allowed based on trust configurations.

classes.name: ExecApprovalEvaluation
classes.description: A struct representing the result of an approval evaluation for a command, including command details, security, allowlist matching, and skill authorization status.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Asynchronously evaluates whether a command is approved based on security policies, allowlist configurations, and trust settings.

methods.name: isSkillAutoAllowed
methods.description: Determines if the command resolution matches trusted skill bin paths for automatic approval.

methods.name: _testIsSkillAutoAllowed
methods.description: Internal test function for 'isSkillAutoAllowed', exposed for testing purposes.
